Proposition
[Variation of the Ricci tensor] 1. ch2:3.7 Source: topping:page-0031, topping:page-0032 \group topping-background

\[ \frac{\partial }{\partial t}\Ric =-\frac12\Delta _{\mathcal L}h-\frac12\mathcal L_{(\delta G(h))^\# }g. \] Equivalently, \[ \frac{\partial }{\partial t}\Ric (X,W) =\Delta \Ric (X,W)-2\langle \Ric (X),\Ric (W)\rangle +2\langle \Rm (X,\cdot ,W,\cdot ),\Ric \rangle . \]
